summary: The change adds an optional limit parameter to Table.search, slicing results when limit is provided while preserving existing behavior when omitted or None. Tests confirm correct limiting on default, None, and named tables, and all existing tests still pass.

checks.claim: search returns limited number of documents when limit is set
checks.evidence: tests/test_limit_seed.py: test_limit_returns_first_matches asserts first two matches are returned

checks.claim: search returns all documents when limit is None or omitted
checks.evidence: tests/test_limit_seed.py: test_limit_none_returns_all asserts full length with and without limit
tests/test_limit_seed.py: test_limit_on_named_table asserts length 2 with limit=2
